title: Neuron Crystal Ball
description: A glowing glass crystal ball sits on a wooden table, its interior displaying a colorful, branching neuron structure with an orange center. A cartoonish green anthropomorphic bacterium with large eyes holds a red heart toward the orb, which features a large stylized blue eye with black eyeliner on its right side.
prompt: A surreal digital painting of a glowing crystal ball on a dark wooden table by a rainy window. Inside the transparent sphere is a vibrant, multi-colored neuron with branching dendrites in pink, blue, and green, centered on a bright orange nucleus. A cute green cartoon bacterium with big eyes floats to the left, holding a small red heart. The crystal ball has a large stylized blue eye with dramatic black eyeliner on its right side. Water droplets cover the glass. Dark moody atmosphere with neon lighting.
